- Primary ask from us: confirm the economic buyer (person who signs and owns budget) and the procurement contact who will run contract review and SOC2 checks.
- What we heard: technical team wants low-latency embedding + private network options, security flagged SOC2 + customer-managed keys, and a predictable committed throughput for Q1 pilot.
- Suggested next steps: 1) share a short internal stakeholder list (2–3 names) for econ buyer and procurement, 2) we send a 1-page pilot proposal + SOC2 summary, 3) sync with procurement for timeline (we typically need 2–3 weeks for standard T&Cs).

Attachments: I’m including a SOC2 summary and a one-pager that frames the pilot economics and trial credits. If you can drop the budget owner and procurement contact, we’ll put together a tailored pilot + mutual action plan.

If it helps, we can join a 15-min call next week to introduce the economics and procurement checklist to your legal/procurement rep. What time window works for Markus or your procurement lead?

Thanks — Rishi

Hi Lydia / Markus — nice to e-meet. Per Rishi’s note I pulled together a short pilot SOW and included a SOC2 one-pager. See attachments: redwood-trial-one-pager.pdf and soc2-summary.pdf.

Key highlights in the SOW:
- Scope: 2-week pilot in a dedicated VPC project, up to 50K inference tokens, model variants recommended: redwood-open-7b-quant and redwood-chat-13b for throughput testing.
- Security: SOC2 Type II controls overview included; support for customer-managed key (temporary test key) is possible via our KMS integration — Aditya is verifying timelines.
- Commercials: complimentary trial credits for the pilot and a capped overage rate if usage exceeds the token budget.
- Next steps: 1) confirm procurement contact and preferred PoC start window, 2) sign an NDA if needed (we have a standard mutual NDA template), 3) schedule 15-min procurement walkthrough with Aditya and me.

Markus — can you confirm the vendor intake contact and any mandatory clauses your legal team requires (data residency, indemnity caps, etc.)? We can highlight those in the SOW.

If this looks good I’ll also prepare a brief slide for the procurement call.

Best — Monica
